def: A text-to-SQL benchmark (Li et al., 2023) of 12,751 question-SQL pairs over 95 large databases totaling 33.4 GB in more than 37 professional domains, scored mainly by execution accuracy.
practice: Harder than schema-only parsing because questions need messy real values and outside knowledge; the BIRD-Interact extension adds conversational and agentic modes, and leaderboard scores should be read with dates.
